lab_questions.title: Healthcare: Real-time Patient Telemetry Virtualized Data Grid
lab_questions.description: An ICU central monitoring dashboard freezes when streaming 50,000+ real-time patient vital sign records simultaneously. Build a high-performance virtualized table component in React/TypeScript that maintains 60 FPS scrolling and supports multi-column filtering without blocking the main thread.

tasks.title: Task 1: DOM Virtualization Viewport Windowing
tasks.description: Implement a custom `useVirtualizer` hook in `src/hooks/useVirtualizer.ts` that calculates `startIndex`, `endIndex`, and `totalHeight` based on container `scrollTop`, `clientHeight`, and uniform `rowHeight`. Ensure only visible rows (plus an overscan buffer of 5) are rendered to the DOM.

file_checks.label: DOM Virtualization windowing calculations in useVirtualizer.ts

scoring_rules.pass_message: Task 1 passed! DOM virtualization viewport windowing implemented.
scoring_rules.fail_hint: Calculate visible rows with Math.floor and push to virtualItems in src/hooks/useVirtualizer.ts.

tasks.title: Task 2: Web Worker Offloaded Sorting & Filtering
tasks.description: Offload multi-column search and sorting calculations on the 50,000-row dataset to a Dedicated Web Worker (`src/workers/filterWorker.ts`) to avoid dropping frames on the main UI thread during fast user keystrokes.

file_checks.label: Web Worker sorting and filtering handler in filterWorker.ts

scoring_rules.pass_message: Task 2 passed! Web Worker offloaded sorting and filtering implemented.
scoring_rules.fail_hint: Filter data with data.filter and send results via self.postMessage(filtered) in src/workers/filterWorker.ts.

tasks.title: Task 3: Dynamic Buffer & Memory Leak Prevention
tasks.description: Clean up scroll listeners, Web Worker instances, and memory references on component unmount to ensure 0 detached DOM nodes and 0 memory leaks across re-renders.

file_checks.label: Worker cleanup and termination in VirtualizedGrid.tsx

scoring_rules.pass_message: Task 3 passed! Memory leak prevention and worker termination implemented.
scoring_rules.fail_hint: Instantiate new Worker and call worker.terminate() inside useEffect cleanup in src/components/VirtualizedGrid.tsx.

lab_questions.title: EdTech: Real-time Collaborative Code Editor with Conflict Resolution
lab_questions.description: In a remote pair-programming and student evaluation platform, two candidates or interviewers can collaborate in real time on code files. Implement optimistic UI state updates, an offline mutation queue with reconnection replay, and a Last-Write-Wins (LWW) timestamp conflict resolution strategy.

tasks.title: Task 1: Optimistic UI Updates with State Rollback
tasks.description: When a user edits code in `src/components/CodeWorkspace.tsx`, immediately update local editor state and dispatch a mutation. If the server rejects the change or WebSocket fails, roll back to the last acknowledged snapshot without jitter.

file_checks.label: Optimistic UI state updates and rollback in collabStore.ts

scoring_rules.pass_message: Task 1 passed! Optimistic UI state updates with rollback implemented.
scoring_rules.fail_hint: Implement applyOptimisticEdit and rollbackEdit restoring lastAcknowledgedCode in src/store/collabStore.ts.

tasks.title: Task 2: Offline Mutation Queue & Reconnection Replay
tasks.description: Implement an offline buffer in `src/services/mutationQueue.ts`. If WebSocket connectivity drops, buffer incoming edits in memory / localStorage and automatically replay them in FIFO order once the socket reconnects.

file_checks.label: Offline mutation queue and FIFO flush replay in mutationQueue.ts

scoring_rules.pass_message: Task 2 passed! Offline mutation queue and FIFO reconnection replay implemented.
scoring_rules.fail_hint: Implement enqueue with push and flush with shift in FIFO order in src/services/mutationQueue.ts.

tasks.title: Task 3: Last-Write-Wins (LWW) Conflict Resolution
tasks.description: Handle concurrent edits by comparing Lamport logical timestamps / ISO timestamps in `src/services/conflictResolver.ts`. Apply edits with higher timestamps and reject outdated mutations safely.

file_checks.label: LWW timestamp conflict resolution in conflictResolver.ts

scoring_rules.pass_message: Task 3 passed! Last-Write-Wins (LWW) conflict resolution implemented.
scoring_rules.fail_hint: Compare localMutation.timestamp vs remoteMutation.timestamp in src/services/conflictResolver.ts.
